sahneler.metin: An accommodation platform in the North Sea suddenly capsized.
Most of the men aboard were trapped, and one hundred twenty three died.
One of its braces had snapped.
A hole had been cut in it to fit a sensor.
The weld around that hole was poor.
A fatigue crack grew from it, wave after wave.
When the brace failed, a leg broke away.
Offshore structures must now survive losing one member.

aciklama:
Alexander Kielland capsized in the North Sea. The cause: fatigue crack from a poor fillet weld at a hydrophone opening, leading to brace and leg failure.

#shorts #engineering #materials
